subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: Should this PR require after-fix live Discord voice proof after the lifecycle cleanup fix, or should a maintainer explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The dependency-backed code path is clear, but the available proof is tests/CI plus pre-fix logs, not an observed fixed two-account Discord voice setup.

options.title: Require live proof after cleanup repair
options.body: Fix the lifecycle ownership issue, then require redacted live output, logs, or a terminal transcript showing account-scoped voice joins or already-ready autoJoin recovery before merge.

options.title: Override proof after code repair
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept dependency-level tests without live Discord proof if no safe two-account voice environment is available.

options.title: Pause until a voice setup is available
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until someone can run a real Discord voice scenario that matches the reported failure.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after cleanup repair
recommendation.body: Fix the lifecycle ownership issue, then require redacted live output, logs, or a terminal transcript showing account-scoped voice joins or already-ready autoJoin recovery before merge.
